name: Rokurokubi
body:
School Transmutation (polymorph); Level druid 3, ranger 3, Witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Duration 10 min/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

Your neck stretches to great lengths. It gives you 5 feet + 5 feet per 4 levels of reach with any bite attack. In addition, you can maneuver your head to have a spell or other effect that originates with your head (your mouth, eyes, etc) to any square within your reach.
